title: Merge Sorted Array
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer m.
Line 2: m space-separated integers, sorted ascending (may be empty).
Line 3: integer n.
Line 4: n space-separated integers, sorted ascending (may be empty).
outputFormat: m + n space-separated integers: the merged array in ascending order.
constraints:
0 <= m, n <= 10^5
1 <= m + n
-10^9 <= values <= 10^9
Both input arrays are already sorted ascending.

examples.explanation: The two sorted arrays interleave into one sorted array of length 6.
The second array is empty, so the result is the first array.
